values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/rainbowbend ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Rainbow Bend State Forest Campground, Crawford: rustic, open all year, Hartwick Pines SP 989-348-7068, 7 sites, $20, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/rainbowbend ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/rainbowbend ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' values.note: 7 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted), plus a canoe group-use area. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/rainbowbend ('There are 7 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'There is a large canoe group use area near the river') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (7 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the Au Sable River, 15 miles east of Grayling via M-72, McMasters Bridge and Conners Flat (Crawford County), with a large canoe group-use area near the river. Trout fishing and paddler access. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 7 sites (confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated). Boilerplate 'tent and small trailer' wording, silent on length. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation 'no'. Phone 989-348-7068 matches.
